question: Should maintainers wait for this external contributor to rebase and add live proof, or replace the work with a maintainer-owned fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43866?
rationale: The bug is valid and P1, but the fork is conflicting, uneditable by maintainers, and missing real behavior proof, so automation cannot safely choose the ownership path.

options.title: Replace On Current Main
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned or trusted repair branch for the linked issue, preserving the useful accountId/test work while rebasing onto SourceDeliveryPlan.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, port the policy change, update docs, and post redacted live WhatsApp hook proof before another merge review.

options.title: Pause Or Close Later
options.body: If no refresh or replacement is planned, close this stale fork after preserving the useful problem statement and tests in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Replace On Current Main
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-owned or trusted repair branch for the linked issue, preserving the useful accountId/test work while rebasing onto SourceDeliveryPlan.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent cross-cutting gateway hooks and source-delivery history points to steipete as the best available owner for deciding replacement versus waiting.
